messenger.empty: No conversations yet. Start one, then invite somebody by their email address.
messenger.notInAnyGroup: You are not in any group yet.
messenger.inviteTooltip: Invite somebody by their email address
messenger.leaveLastTooltip: You are the last one here — leaving closes the conversation
messenger.deleteGroupTooltip: Delete this conversation for everyone in it
messenger.inviteHint: The whole address, exactly. There is no list to pick from: you can only invite somebody whose address you already know.

confirm.leaveBody: Are you sure you want to leave this conversation? The others will be told that you left, and you will stop seeing it.
confirm.leaveLastBody: You are the only one left in this conversation, so leaving will delete it along with every message and attachment in it. This cannot be undone.
confirm.deleteGroupBody: Are you sure you want to delete this conversation? Every message and attachment in it will be removed for everyone, and this cannot be undone.
confirm.deleteMessageBody: Are you sure you want to delete this message?

messenger.noGroupsForAccount: Your account cannot see any groups. Ask an administrator to add you to one.
messenger.onceAdded: Once you are added to a group, its conversation appears here.
messenger.selectOne: Select a conversation to read it.
messenger.callNotMember: You can read this group but are not in it
messenger.callOffline: Reconnecting — calls need the live connection
messenger.callBusy: You are already in a call
messenger.cannotRead: You cannot read messages in this group.
messenger.readOnly: You can read this conversation but not post to it.

auth.weakPassword: Choose a password that meets all four requirements.
auth.googleFailed: Google sign-in failed. Please try again.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.subtitle: Your name, your picture and the language you read the app in.
profile.emailFixed: The address you sign in with cannot be changed here.
profile.emailConfirmedYes: Confirmed — you signed in with Google, or an administrator confirmed it.
profile.emailConfirmedNo: Not confirmed yet. Sign in with Google, or ask an administrator.

picture.rules: A square PNG or JPEG, at least 64×64, no more than 1024×1024 and under 1024KB.
picture.createFirst: A picture can be added once the account exists.

error.notPlaced: The call could not be placed.
error.dropped: The connection dropped, so the call ended.
error.micRefusedCalling: A microphone is needed to call, and permission was refused.
error.micRefusedAnswering: A microphone is needed to answer, and permission was refused.
error.offlineCalling: You are offline, so the call could not be placed.
error.offlineAnswering: You are offline, so the call could not be answered.

dashboard.noPermissions: Your account has no permissions yet, so there is nothing to manage here. Ask an administrator for a role.

panels.confirmDeleteBody: Are you sure you want to delete the {{item}} “{{name}}”? This cannot be undone.

roles.explainer: A role is a bundle of permissions. Permissions are generated from the models registered on the server — one per model and CRUD action, plus an own-only variant for models whose rows belong to a user.
roles.systemNote: This is a system role. Its permissions are kept in sync with the full model catalog on every server start, so manual changes will be reset.
roles.name: Role name
roles.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete the “{{name}}” role? Users holding it will lose the permissions it grants.
roles.title: Roles

groups.ownerFixed: Your permission covers your own groups, so this one is filed under you.
groups.ownerNeedsUsers: Choosing another owner needs permission to read users.
groups.membersNeedUsers: Membership cannot be edited without permission to read users.
groups.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete group #{{id}}, owned by {{owner}}? Its messages and attachments go with it, and this cannot be undone.

messages.noGroupYet: There is no group to post into yet — create one first.
messages.author: Author
messages.authorFixedEdit: Who wrote it does not change.
messages.authorFixed: Your permission covers your own messages, so this is sent as you.
messages.authorNeedsUsers: Writing as somebody else needs permission to read users.
messages.removeNote: Removing one deletes it when the change is saved.
messages.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this message? “{{preview}}”
messages.confirmDeleteReplies_one: {{count}} reply will stay, no longer pointing at it.
messages.confirmDeleteReplies_other: {{count}} replies will stay, no longer pointing at it.

users.noneUntilRole: None — this user cannot do anything until a role is assigned.
users.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete “{{name}}”? Everything they own goes with them, and this cannot be undone.
